This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|gray]] and red skin, as well as short fleshy points on their cheeks, chin, and the back of their heads.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[3 BBY]], a member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], pushing a cart near the [[Niki-Bon Travel Agency]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:UnidentifiedPointyCheekedSpecies-IvanManzella.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Ivan Manzella.]]
The species made their debut in the [[I Have Friends Everywhere|fifth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref>
